name: good_stored_proc_migration
legacy_text: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE build_customer_ltv() AS BEGIN CREATE TEMP TABLE _completed AS SELECT customer_id, amount FROM raw_orders WHERE status='completed'; CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE analytics.customer_ltv AS SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS lifetime_value, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CASE WHEN SUM(amount)>=150 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS ltv_segment FROM _completed GROUP BY customer_id; END;

rubric.name: logic_fidelity
rubric.description: Does the mart reproduce completed-only filter, SUM/COUNT, the >=150 segment threshold, per-customer grain?

rubric.name: decomposition
rubric.description: Is the proc split into staging + mart models wired with ref(), not a monolith reading raw tables directly?

rubric.name: test_quality
rubric.description: Are there meaningful tests (unique/not_null on grain, accepted_values on segment)?

rubric.name: docs
rubric.description: Is there a migration_changes.md and/or model descriptions explaining the mapping?

files.models/staging/stg_orders.sql: select cast(order_id as integer) as order_id, cast(customer_id as integer) as customer_id, status, cast(amount as decimal(18,2)) as amount from {{ ref('raw_orders') }}
files.models/marts/mart_customer_ltv.sql: with completed as (select customer_id, amount from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} where status='completed'), final as (select customer_id, cast(sum(amount) as decimal(18,2)) as lifetime_value, count(*) as order_count, case when sum(amount)>=150 then 'high' else 'low' end as ltv_segment from completed group by customer_id) select * from final
files.models/marts/_marts.yml:
version: 2
models:
  - name: mart_customer_ltv
    description: Customer lifetime value migrated from sp_customer_ltv; completed orders only, >=150 -> high.
    columns:
      - name: customer_id
        description: Grain one row per customer.
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: ltv_segment
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: ['high','low']
files.migration_changes.md:
# Migration changes

| Legacy | dbt |
|---|---|
| TEMP TABLE _completed | completed CTE |
| CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE customer_ltv | mart_customer_ltv |
| raw_orders read | stg_orders via ref() |

Threshold >=150 -> high preserved. Grain: one row per customer.
